rule_semantics.G0: pass_min_ply=0; pass is legal on every nonterminal state.
rule_semantics.G1-pass8: pass_min_ply=8; action at zero-based ply0..7 forbidden; legal at ply8, the ninth action. Earliest double-pass terminal is after10 actions. Same rule applies to real moves, tree nodes, expansion and uniform rollout.
rule_semantics.no_legal_nonpass: Fail closed with NoLegalActionError during banned window. Never pass, skip turn, score early, alter superko, resample or silently replace a game. Abort current game/search and pause pilot; preserve fault state, current game and traceback. No outcome is imputed. This is an explicitly partial rule probe outside no-action states, not a total rule extension.
rule_semantics.unchanged: Black first; area scoring; no suicide; non-pass situational superko; legal pass superko exemption/history; doublepass precedence over100-ply cap; simple vector identity utilities.

statistics.estimand: G1 minus G0 average outcome under independent pseudorandom-stream replications of the fixed tested design. Equal six batch-seed by orientation strata pooled; equal two orientations per named seed. Arbitrary within-pair dependence and heterogeneous probabilities allowed. Fixed deterministic seed results themselves have no sampling uncertainty; CIs describe hypothetical stream replications and do not generalize to unrun policies, agent seeds or batch seeds.
statistics.paired_goal_method: Let D=Y_G1-Y_G0, n01=sum(D=1), n10=sum(D=-1), with ordered bits(G0,G1). At target confidence1-alpha construct two TWO-SIDED equal-tail Clopper-Pearson component CIs each at1-alpha/2 for n01/n and n10/n. Return[Lplus-Uminus,Uplus-Lminus]. Union-bound projection; no component-independence assumption. Heterogeneous-average coverage justified by Mattner-Tasto2015 theorem1.3/arXiv1403.0229v3 theorem1.12; do not use one-sidedCP.
statistics.marginal_rates: Two-sided equal-tailCP95percent; report successes/n. Black/white board/identity outcomes separate. Mixed joint goals count once pergame. WW/LL never replaced by same aggregate.
statistics.length_method: For paired D=length_G1-length_G0 in[-90,98], Hoeffding CI clips meanD +/- 188*sqrt(log(2/alpha)/(2*n)) to[-90,98]. Independent bounded, not necessarily identical, paired-block outcomes. No normal approximation/bootstrap uncertainty claim.
statistics.extra_length: Length minus(rule pass_min_ply+2); extra delta=rawdelta-8 exactly; interval=rawinterval-8. A derived relabeling, not another family endpoint and not causal removal of mechanical effects.
statistics.multiplicity: One pooled eight-estimand family: WW blackgoaldelta,LL blackgoaldelta,WL jointgoaldelta,LW jointgoaldelta,and4direction rawlengthdeltas. Eachalpha=.05/8=.00625; simultaneousfamily coverage>=95percent byBonferroni. PairedCP componentconfidence=.996875. Extra mirrors raw. Other95percent CIs, all perseed and perstratum CIs are pointwise only, never simultaneously valid across these panels.
statistics.audit: Hoeffding goalCI shown separately usingD in[-1,1]; do not choose tighter method or intersect intervals.
statistics.full_sample_only: No formal intervals on partial data. Fixed480, no outcome-based stopping/expansion, no pvalues/significanceflags/equivalence/rare-failure certification.

Pointwise n20 all-concordant halfwidth0.1967596797. Family95percentHoeffding length halfwidth41.21847657actions, perseed pointwise57.09197742. statistics.pooling: Only formal480; exclude48pilot, D0,D1 and old15600. All six fixed strata equal size10. Raw/fullsample results remain primary; no removal of shortgames.
statistics.events: Pass proposals and accepted responses have explicit event opportunities and available-next-action denominator. Repeated proposals within game dependent; descriptive only, no event-as-independent-game CIs.

boundaries: Effect is whole early-pass rule intervention including changed trajectories and search branches, not isolated pure terminal-channel effect
